title: Housing: unit-by-unit tracking with on-site evidence
excerpt: COBRA Housing verifies the progress of each home improvement with geotagged photo records and subsidy control.
content:
COBRA Housing verifies the progress of each home improvement with geotagged photo records and subsidy control.

The challenge of small scale

A housing improvement program isn't one large project; it's thousands of small, geographically dispersed ones, each with its own beneficiary and subsidy. Aggregate oversight doesn't work; you need to be able to look at a specific home.

How it's solved

  • Progress recorded per unit: each home, building or phase has its own status.
  • Geo-referencing: every intervention located on the map.
  • Photo evidence with date and accountable person.
  • Traceability of subsidies and disbursements per beneficiary.

When every home has its own digital file, the question "What was the subsidy spent on?" has an immediate answer.

Offline mode

Much of this work happens where there's no signal. The mobile apps capture progress offline and sync automatically once the connection returns, so a lack of network never becomes a lack of evidence.

Impact on the beneficiary relationship

Transparency also flows downward: when beneficiary families can check the status of their home improvement, mistrust decreases and complaints become specific and resolvable.
